newsitem.title: USA: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle $107/dressed basis - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Iowa-S Minn fed cattle $107/dressed basis - USDA.

text.p: Slaughter steers and heifers were not fully established, with a higher undertone noted, compared to Tuesday's close, USDA said. Trade was moderate to active. Demand strong. Seller interest moderate to strong. Offerings were light.
Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1200-1300 lbs few 64.50-65.00. Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 no sales.
Carcass Basis (weight only) Compared Mondays close - Slaughter steers and heifers $1.00 to mostly $2.00 higher.

Steers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1150-1300 lbs 106.00-107.00 few 107.25 Holstein - (weight only) Select and Choice 2-3 1250-1400 lbs few 102.00 ld 103.00 Holsteins - ( grade and weight) Choice 2-3 1250-1450 lbs few 104.00-105.00 Select 2-3 1250-1450 lbs 97.00-98.00.
Heifers - Select to mostly Choice 2-4 1050-1200 lbs 106.00-107.00.
